subject: [video] WP09 DONE: vectors, manifest, embedded_vectors.h, check_vectors 152/152
body:
DONE WP09. All owned files under gpu/video/vectors/ are implemented and tested on the host; no phone, no publish. Commit bab018a3 (only gpu/video/vectors).

TEST COMMANDS AND LAST LINES
1) bash gpu/video/vectors/check_vectors.sh  ->  N2TEST WP09 PASS 152/152  (~11 s, one core, leaves no data)
2) bash gpu/video/vectors/run_tests.sh       ->  N2TEST WP09 PASS 152/152  (forwards to 1)
3) python3 gpu/video/vectors/check_gen_yuv.py <tmp>  ->  CHECKS 40
4) python3 gpu/video/vectors/make_embedded.py --verify --data <tmp>/data --manifest <tmp>/manifest.json --out gpu/video/vectors/embedded_vectors.h  ->  N2VEC verify PASS: h264 8 AUs, hevc 8 AUs, jpeg 3339 B, heic 1461 B, total 12618 B (budget 49152)
5) du -sb gpu/video/vectors  ->  181826

WHAT check_vectors.sh PROVES (152 checks): gen_yuv literals (gradient first bytes 00 01 02 03, Y(5,7)=19; noise 60,94,129; squares/text/pan/static/PPM literals; 18x18 i420+nv12; 1920x1080 frame in 0.37 s < 3 s); regenerates 'quick' twice into a temp dir and requires the manifest to be byte-identical both times; every raw sha256 and exact size; every stream sha256, ffmpeg exit 0, frame count, per-frame md5 and first-frame luma md5; clang -Wall -Wextra -Werror compiles embedded_vectors.h included twice; dumps the header and independently decodes the reconstructed H.264/HEVC Annex-B (frame count + frame-0 luma md5) and the JPEG/HEIC; regenerates embedded_vectors.h and compares byte for byte; AVCC->Annex-B round trip inside make_embedded; du -sb < 40000000.

CONTENTS: quick = 176x144 x10 for all six patterns, 178x146 x10 squares, 640x480 x10 squares+pan (11.34 MiB); six streams from squares 176x144: H.264 Constrained Baseline QP28 (3446 B), H.264 High CABAC+B QP28 (2684 B), HEVC Main QP30 no B (4393 B), JPEG q85 (3339 B), HEIC (1461 B), AV1 2 frames (952 B). full adds 1280x720 x10 and 1920x1080/1918x1078 x4 (50.95 MB total; must 'make_vectors.sh clean' before the 40 MB check).

FOR WP07: embedded_vectors.h has your proposed generic n2vec_streams[]/n2vec_stream_count()=2 and n2vec_images[]/n2vec_image_count()=2 plus n2vec_count()=4 and the named arrays; all static const, include guard, 12 618 B of data.
FOR WP10: manifest.json version 1, paths relative to vectors/data, frame_md5[] and luma_md5_first_frame; gen_yuv.py has all six patterns (text too) and the exact CLI in the task.
DEVIATIONS (in STATUS.json + STATUS.md): heif-enc 1.23.7 cannot read PPM, so HEIC is made via a lossless PNG from the same PPM (both commands recorded); pan/static chroma is neutral 128 because the package defines luma only; x264/x265/aomenc get --ref 1/--threads 1/--pools 1 for determinism; 178x146/640x480 quick sets use a subset of patterns to stay under the 40 MB cap.

STATUS: gpu/video/vectors/STATUS.json and gpu/video/dsh/workers/WP09/STATUS.md (pasted output). Ready for review; I will answer board requests.
